summary: Flat headline (XJO -0.14%) masked a decisive rotation out of resources and crowded tech into domestic cyclicals, financials, insurance and gold. WiseTech -18.4% on an AFP probe of chair Richard White drove IT -4.20%; iron ore ~US$101 (-8% MoM) dragged Materials. Smart Money surged into Multiline Insurance (#46->1) and consumer cyclicals. Small Ords printed full Bullish. RBA held 4.35% on 16 Jun (next 10-11 Aug).
